scope: Read all 23 declarations, both parameter tables, complete fixture/hook setup and relevant production paths. Keep all 28 runtime cases; strengthen independent project output, selected SSH-host filtering, complete clone identity and structured refusals. Replace assertion-dependent process-status restoration with suite teardown. No actual repository, setup, server, network or native app operation.
changes: Exercise actual human project formatting and require the complete GitHub identity and providerless folder rows in one output; the original --json case checked only the project.list call and could pass with broken human output.

Require a structured incompatible_runtime refusal after method_not_found, retain actionable update text and exclude the raw unknown-method message; exit state is reset/restored even if an assertion fails.
Preserve unknown runtime-host rejection, empty known environments and no setup-list dispatch; require the false error envelope and failure-safe exit cleanup.
An actual empty SSH-target response must produce structured invalid_argument and the named missing-target message, without fetching setups; teardown restores exit state after failure.
A paired environment mistakenly selected via ssh must return structured invalid_argument plus --environment awin recovery; preserve its real paired-store and empty-target inputs.

Add a second setup on a different SSH host and require only the full selected row, so bypassing host filtering fails; resolve the user label through the actual target lookup rather than pre-normalizing the flag.
Malformed runtime: must produce structured invalid_argument and the exact invalid-host explanation before any runtime request; reset and restore process status with suite hooks.

Conflicting runtime-host and pairing-code selection must reject with structured invalid_argument, specific mutually exclusive selector advice and no runtime request; cleanup must run after assertion failure.
Paired-server setup must reject a client-relative path before any RPC, require structured invalid_argument and retain the remote absolute-path explanation.
SSH setup must reject the same relative spelling even on a local runtime connection because the path belongs to the SSH target; require structured invalid_argument and no request.
Pairing-code repo.add must reject client-relative input with structured invalid_argument and absolute remote-path advice before any request.
Require the complete clone request, including projectId, runtime hostId and clone URL beside unchanged Windows destination, so a correct destination cannot hide cloning the wrong repository.

Require status.get as the sole request, a single structured incompatible_runtime refusal with host-target update explanation, and failure status; the original no-delete-only assertion could pass for unrelated early errors.
source_domains: Complete original/final source, every declaration/array/loop/lifecycle span, all seven literal parameter rows with separate reasons, and all 28 baseline/reviewed runtime instances are embedded in the ledger.
